channel.title: Newshound
channel.description: The day’s news, found by following where expectations shifted.

item.title: State Department and White House deny report that Rubio will quit to run in 2028
item.description: The administration denied a report in The Independent that Marco Rubio is getting ready to resign as secretary of state and challenge JD Vance for the 2028 Republican nomination, calling it a "baseless hoax."

item.title: Nigerian court voids Atiku's ADC presidential ticket and sacks party leadership
item.description: A Federal High Court in Abuja nullified Atiku Abubakar's nomination as the ADC candidate for January's election, removing a main opposition rival to Peter Obi; the ADC says it will appeal.

item.title: AI stock rout after midterms clouds Anthropic's planned November IPO
item.description: A deep Thursday selloff in AI and chip stocks, tied to Democratic midterm gains and worries about data center financing, raised doubts that Anthropic can list before Thanksgiving as planned.

item.title: State Department denies reports that Rubio is weighing resignation
item.description: Rubio's office called reports in The Independent and Bloomberg that he may quit ahead of a 2028 run "fake news" and said he will keep serving.

item.title: Arab parties back Eisenkot, giving him a majority of recommendations for prime minister
item.description: With 67 of 120, he's expected to get the first chance to form Israel's next government.
